title: Will of God
definition: The will of God refers to His holy purposes, commands, desires, and sovereign plan revealed in Scripture and carried out in His wisdom.
summary: God's will is holy, wise, and trustworthy.
christFocus: Jesus perfectly obeyed the Father's will and teaches His people to seek and do it.

studySections.heading: Doctrine in Summary
studySections.content:
Scripture speaks of God's will in more than one way. God has a sovereign will by which He accomplishes His purposes, and a revealed will by which He commands His people.

Believers are not called to decode every hidden purpose. They are called to obey what God has revealed and trust Him with what remains hidden.

Christ perfectly submitted to the Father's will, even in suffering. His obedience becomes both the ground of salvation and the pattern for discipleship.

studySections.heading: Why This Matters
studySections.content: Many people become anxious trying to discover hidden details while ignoring clear obedience. The will of God matters because it teaches trust, wisdom, and obedience.

studySections.heading: Discipleship and Application
studySections.content: Begin with what God has revealed. Obey His commands, pray for wisdom, and trust His sovereign will when circumstances are unclear.
